title: DPLM: Dynamics-aware Protein Language Model via contrastive learning between sequence and molecular dynamics simulation trajectory
authors: Yuexu Jiang; Duolin Wang; Ibrahim A. Imam; Dong Xu; Qing Shao
one_liner_zh: 该文提出动力学感知蛋白语言模型DPLM，通过对比学习对齐序列与MD轨迹嵌入，虽非直接研究TF-DNA互作，但其动态特性建模方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA结合机制研究。
abstract: Protein dynamics play a critical role in protein function, yet such important information is missing in many protein language models (PLM). We introduce DPLM, a dynamics-aware protein language model that aligns sequence embeddings with molecular dynamics (MD) trajectory embeddings via contrastive learning. Using MD features encoded by a pretrained video model, DPLM learns sequence representations that correlate with residue-level flexibility and improve protein-level functional clustering compared to static sequence- and structure-based PLMs. Without task-specific training, DPLM outperforms ESM-based representations in zero-shot mutation-effect prediction on multiple deep mutational scanning datasets. When adapted with lightweight task-specific heads, DPLM further achieves top-tier performance on protein stability prediction and intrinsic disorder region identification, demon-strating that contrastive alignment with MD trajectories enables PLMs to capture biologically meaningful dynamic properties.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质动力学在蛋白质功能中扮演关键角色，然而在许多蛋白质语言模型（PLM）中，这一重要信息却缺失。我们引入了DPLM，一种动力学感知的蛋白质语言模型，通过对比学习将序列嵌入与分子动力学（MD）轨迹嵌入对齐。利用预训练视频模型编码的MD特征，DPLM学习到的序列表示与残基级灵活性相关，并在蛋白质级功能聚类上优于基于静态序列和结构的PLM。无需任务特定训练，DPLM在多个深度突变扫描数据集上的零样本突变效应预测中优于基于ESM的表示。当适配轻量级任务特定头时，DPLM在蛋白质稳定性预测和内在无序区域识别上进一步达到顶级性能，表明与MD轨迹的对比对齐使PLM能够捕捉生物学上有意义的动态特性。
